places.quote: going to the City to-night and meeting my sister
places.note: Dickens's term for the financial City; also 'London city' in the passage.

places.quote: the schoolmaster and the pupil emerged upon the Leadenhall Street region
places.note: Written as 'Leadenhall Street region', so the area is meant.

places.quote: dismal Newgate seems quite as fit a stronghold for the mighty Lord Mayor as his own state-dwelling
places.note: Newgate gaol, used in a comparison.
